title: Studio rails: a search with no matches shows a blank list with no "no matches" message (object rail, permission-set rail)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A builder who mistypes a search sees an empty column and cannot tell whether the list failed to load.

## Reproduction

1. Data › object rail search "zzzz" → blank.
2. Access › permission-set rail search "zzzz" → blank.

## Expected

An empty-search state naming the query, with a clear action.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`StudioRail.tsx` (shared rail search).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Data and Access QA cards.
- Business reason: Small, but it reads as a broken page.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio rail search with no matches shows blank list no empty state` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 3 hits, none about Studio rails (closed #25898, #23004, #6675).
- QA id: U8
